question: Which pairing correctly identifies methods of charging a body?

options.A: Friction — transfer by rubbing (contact); Conduction — transfer by direct contact with a charged body.
options.B: Friction — no physical contact; Conduction — no physical contact.
options.C: Friction — requires earthing; Conduction — requires earthing.
options.D: Friction — neutralizes a body; Conduction — cannot change a body's net charge.
